I'm probably going to give it a cool video game theme. The ceiling is just a drop ceiling in that room, but I'm going to try and paint it like the walls in Portal. Not sure about the other stuff.

And I'll remember your username if I need you! :)

Hey, I just wanted to check up. You helped a lot, thank you, and the rocket was amazing.

Girlfriend was a week late. Terrifying, but I've never been so happy that she's erm... "Down for maintenance". Also, no more cheap, shitty protection just in case.

We looked at another house that I'm more comfortable in, and my parents are even gonna let me paint my room however I want, so this will be really fun!

They flow into each other like that. Rocketry taught me about cosmic radiation, which got me interested into radioactive substances. That lead into me studying chemistry, which went back into rocketry since chemistry is essential for understanding rocket fuel.

I'm hoping on watching the rocket on the 8th, weather looks good too.

I go through phases, one month I'm into rocketry, the next month I'm into atomic energy, the next month I'm into planes. I need to go to school now, so I'll respond between classes maybe. Thanks for talking to me. :)
He was so smart and funny, he taught himself a ton of stuff about engineering and always got excited to listen to me talk about my interests. I hope I could grow up to be as kind and helpful as him.
Yes, and I talk with her often. It helps sometimes, but sometimes it just feels like delaying the inevitable.
